I’ll work as a servant if I can’t find any other job.

Raw: agálun (from ágad) n master, boss. v1[A123S] happen to get a master. Nakaagawun akug dagmalan, I happened to work for a cruel master. 2[A2SN] for animals or possessions to allow only the owner to make use of it. Nag-agawun kining ákung kabáyù, aku ray makakabayù, My horse is choosy. I’m the only one who can ride on him. paN-v[A2S; b(1)] work for a master. Mangagálun lang kug way láing kapangabuhían, I’ll work as a servant if I can’t find any other job. Insik ang íyang gipangagawunan, He worked for a Chinese.†
